propositions: The workflow editor must present a read-only Effective Policy view derived from CriteriaSnapshot alongside the editable Authored Workflow topology, with no mutations or serialization of edits back into workflow or project routing.
Saving a project code-review LLM criterion with missing, empty, non-list, or blank applies_to globs must be rejected with an actionable error message suggesting the ["**"] repository-wide remedy.
Built-in secondary triggers, project DET selector controls, and plan-review applies_at/trigger authoring must remain valid and exempt from the project-LLM glob validation rule.
Snapshot load or validation failure must mark Effective Policy unavailable with a located, actionable error and prevent invalid saves; packaged defaults must never be substituted silently.
The authored workflow document must round-trip byte-equivalently while the Effective Policy view changes with project policy, verified by contract and DOM tests.
